	### Compatibility
944f4dda5f784e266310978b31f65b3d452e6387 35 35
	
944f4dda5f784e266310978b31f65b3d452e6387 36 36
	Mirrors renderAuditEvent over renderEventArticle with data-event-type=audit: the label reads label/title/event/status/state/reason/text (default Audit Event), the timestamp reads timestamp/datetime/time/at/createdAt/updatedAt, and the detail reads detail/description/reason/message/from/to/code, so a lone reason is both label and detail exactly as the HTML renderer shows it; authored children replace the generated article body. typeField lowers to event and timestampField to timestamp; timezoneParameter is consumed.
